🐻‍❄️ New mainnet test release: `tests@v21.0.2` — https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests@v21.0.2

This is a [patch release](https://steel.ethereum.foundation/docs/execution-specs/running_tests/releases/#versioning-scheme): no consensus changes!

🧪 BPO test forks now follow Amsterdam ([#3597](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3597)) <@547171287831805972> <@755913785620824175> 

📦 Ported static tests have 32% less EngineX pre-alloc groups (3,337 to 2,255) ([#3758](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3758), [#3876](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3876)) <@892053833121923094> 

🆕 New in this release:
- Merkle Patricia Trie test suite ([#3600](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3600)) <@703742742135570499> 
- Precompile boundary warmth & 7702 authority `SELFDESTRUCT` ([#3676](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3676)) <@508125616940515329> <@796570016966770688>
- Tx gas limit vs floor-inclusive block gas used ([#3832](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3832)) <@412614104222531604> 
- Gas allowance in canonical order and withdrawals pinned before request system calls ([#3827](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3827), [#3835](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3835)) <@796570016966770688> 
- EELS fixes with coverage: modexp base length overflow <Osaka ([#3806](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3806)) <@755913785620824175>, legacy chain ids > 64 bits ([#3828](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3828)) <@796570016966770688> , and empty or `0xff`-prefixed tx bytes ([#3861](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3861))  @EddyW19

PTAL at the [release notes](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests@v21.0.2) for the full list!
